note: Campground on the wooded bluff top above the Wisconsin-Mississippi confluence, beside the Peterson Interpretive Shelter (firewood at its concession stand). The outer ridge-edge sites are mostly non-electric. The park's dump station is at the Homestead campground entrance. Sites fit a 23-ft rig. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page + campground map read: Ridge sites 101-155 (54 drawn), 24 electric, showers, flush + vault toilets, water; reservations required, no walk-up. Riverview PROPOSED DOWN to not waterfront (outer sites back onto continuous forest dropping ~110 m in ~150 m; river ~200 m off; no view source). Pin kept. GTC fees/lengths unread.
